record: One productive QUY Keep editing control author draft, complete intent adaptation

rows.complete_value_rationale: Productive intent-preserving Return to editing command. Software editing is nominalized allichay, with goal -man, followed by intransitive return imperative kutiy. This is not an exact upstream UI phrase or literal suffix-for-keep substitution. The direct caller dismisses a replacement/exit confirmation without running Save or Discard; return to current editing is the user-visible choice.
semantic_obligations: Preserve continued access to current editing rather than authorizing pending New/Load/read/exit. Do not imply Save occurred or edits were discarded.
Intransitive kutiy returns to activity; unlike causative kutichiy used for Undo, it does not mean rollback or reverse the edits.
Do not claim reopening the document, selecting the Edit panel, restarting a task from scratch, replaying a drawing stroke, or a data-protection guarantee.
The confirmation already applies any pending gesture before showing; this caption does not promise that selecting it undoes that application.
No final period or placeholder introduced. Surrounding unsaved-image warning remains unaccepted.

bounded_evidence.role: Definition explicitly describes returning to activity after sleep. Supplies action-nominal + goal-man + base return verb, not merely physical navigation.
Context glossed continue working after eating. Corroborates work/activity-return sense; its person/purpose/inchoative morphology is not copied into the imperative.
Base intransitive return verb; noun/activity-return construction above provides the nonphysical applicability.

sections.role: Infinitive-y creates a verbal noun that functions as an argument.
Singular command-y is formally identical to infinitive-y; base kuti+y is command form.
